name: Ki Poison (Su)
body:
Benefit(s): The ninja can infuse one poison with her own life-force, increasing its potency. This increases the save DC of one poison she uses to 10 + 1/2 her ninja level + her Charisma modifier. Each use of this ability uses up 1 ki point.
